caption: The drawing features a single tall candlestick with a lit candle, positioned centrally within a rectangular border. The candlestick has an ornate, fluted base with multiple curved and ridged sections, rendered in gray and accented with faint bluish and purplish tones. The stem of the candlestick narrows then flares near the top before holding a vertical, slender white candle. The candle exhibits subtle shading, with hints of blue and yellow along its length, and is slightly melted at the tip, with a small visible black wick. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned, and the surface on which the candlestick rests appears flat and partially reflective, with muted blue hues. The entire composition is enclosed by two fine rectangular lines, creating a double-border effect.
title: Candlesticks
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
